svg.text: Warden jump slam in all three views (rig poses only, no new parts) with landing-dust + slam-cracks; slam cracks on the main attack; rally flag in flight; Ranger shockwave; Colossus Charge.
Warden jump slam: crouch → airborne → land, every view
Shadow stays on the ground (code). Landing: landing-dust ring at the feet + slam-cracks-wide from the hammer’s ground point (magenta = rig attach "hammer-ground").

svg.text: Warden main slam: the hammer hits, cracks split out from the hit
slam-cracks (ground) at the "hammer-ground" attach point at impact. Front/back: the clip swaps the upright hammer for the slammed-down one (group "slam").
